audit_scope: Independent design, input reconstruction and native measurement review. No candidate benchmark output inspected and no performance experiment performed by this audit.
auditor_role: Separate workload/design auditor from generator, native adapter and oracle implementers

checks: Reference intervals equal supplied genomic sequences
Random parents reconstruct from retained seeds
Large edit position/length/payload agree with metadata
Small edits reconstruct every target exactly
Deletion/substitution incompatibilities and coordinate ranges checked
All matched pairs share prescribed masks, directions, offsets and inserted bases
All observed counts are Bernoulli outcomes, not fixed-count rate guarantees

limitations: Semisynthetic injected errors, not real reads or calibrated sequencing noise
Eight E. coli loci do not establish cross-genome, platform or hardware generalization
WFA workspace is reused within each batch and its setup/teardown amortized; this is not a per-pair cold-start comparison
Public reference background does not establish variant-calling or association-study benefit
Oracle correctness and adapter execution tests are recorded separately; this audit did not rerun alignments

measurement_review.bootstrap: 9999 paired resamples of eight complete loci, overhead allocated equally across 192 cases
measurement_review.correctness_checks: Scores and replayed =XID CIGARs checked against independent oracle; all supplied finite prototype lower/upper bounds checked
measurement_review.failure_handling: Errors/missing outputs invalidate comparisons; per-batch 300-second timeout terminates complete process group
measurement_review.format_checks: Method IDs, batch identity and finite nonnegative timing fields validated
measurement_review.objective: Exact global unit-cost Levenshtein with full traceback for all six methods
measurement_review.primary_estimator: sum of per-case medians across seven repeats plus median per-batch setup and teardown
measurement_review.rss: Fresh Python wrapper runs exactly one adapter child and records Linux RUSAGE_CHILDREN.ru_maxrss. Whole-process KiB, includes preloaded inputs and retained outputs; not per-alignment auxiliary memory. Wrapper execution is outside native timers.
measurement_review.warmup_validation: Separate excluded outer warmup invocations emit records and receive the same validation
measurement_review.wfa2: edit/end2end/compute_alignment/no heuristic/one thread; predeclared high and ultralow memory modes

pre_timing_corrections_reviewed: Added prototype trace and lower-bound output to satisfy written interval-validation plan
Added explicit method/batch identity and timing-field validation
Made missing optional RSS values safe to summarize
Replaced unavailable /usr/bin/time with isolated Python RSS wrapper without changing native measured region
